facts.text: Serve the mains when the Gourmet Club menu gets read out.
facts.why: The transcript has Carmine asking what is being served and Larry London answering Hawaiian tigerfish and smoked turkey. Wikipedia calls it Larry London revealing the truth, not a menu read out.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Larry London reveals what is really on the plates.

vibe.verdict: A fun fake invitation and bill of fare that nails the Vito lookalike, the Komodo dragon and the con.
